# sherpa-markdown-editor

A Markdown text, edited as it reads: bold reads bold, a heading large, a list draws its bullets, and a mark shows while the caret is in its span. Its toolbar: Undo and Redo, the text style, Bold and Italic, the lists, Outdent and Indent, a link, a comment, code, an image and a table; and the switch to the Markdown itself. A value `{node.name}` reads as a purple chip of its words (`.valueLabels`), and `insertValue(key)` puts one at the caret. Figma "Markdown Editor" (ACP file, 2306:17891). Will, plan 892

## When to use it

For a long text a reader formats — a message, a note, a runbook's steps — written in Markdown and shown as it reads as they type, with a switch to the Markdown itself. Its `value` is the Markdown; `{node.name}` values read as purple chips (`.valueLabels` gives their words), and `insertValue(key)` puts one at the caret. For one line of plain text, use `sherpa-input-text`; for a chat prompt, `sherpa-prompt-composer`.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-markdown-editor name="message" data-label="Message" data-description="What the reader gets: Markdown, with values" placeholder="Write the message" value="## Patch plan&#10;Hi {recipient.first_name},&#10;**{runs.planned} Runs** are planned for {customer.name}:&#10;- Servers: an *MSP admin* approves first&#10;- Workstations: tonight"></sherpa-markdown-editor>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-description` | text |  | a line under the label |
| `data-error` | text |  | a message under the box, in the critical bar |
| `data-help-href` | text |  | where "More about markdown" goes (default CommonMark's help); empty hides it |
| `data-label` | text |  | the field's label (hidden when empty) |
| `data-view` | `formatted` `markdown` |  | formatted \| markdown: the text as it reads (default), or the Markdown itself. The switch writes it |
| `disabled` | boolean, native | `false` | native attributes; readonly shows the text as it reads, with no toolbar |
| `name` | text, native |  | native attributes; readonly shows the text as it reads, with no toolbar |
| `placeholder` | text, native |  | words in the empty box |
| `readonly` | boolean, native | `false` | native attributes; readonly shows the text as it reads, with no toolbar |
| `required` | boolean, native | `false` | native attributes; readonly shows the text as it reads, with no toolbar |
| `value` | text, native |  | the Markdown text (also a JS property) |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `checkValidity()` | Is it acceptable, as its form sees it? |
| `reportValidity()` | Check, and show the browser's message on the control. |
| `insertValue(key: string)` | Put a value at the caret — over the selection — as typed: `input` goes out. |
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions)` | The box takes the focus, in the view shown. |
| `formDisabledCallback()` | Inside a disabled `<fieldset>`, as by its own `disabled`. |
| `formResetCallback()` | Its form was reset: the text it was given in markup. |
| `formStateRestoreCallback(state: string)` | Back, or a session restored: the text the form kept. |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `input` | `{ value: string }` | The text changed: typed, pasted or pressed. |
| `change` | `{ value: string }` | The text changed while the editor held focus, and focus left it. |
| `view-change` | `{ view: 'formatted' \| 'markdown' }` | The switch picked a view. |
